description: Evaluate non-stop range feasibility (`feasibilityStatus`), Breguet allowable payload, flight duration, and all-cabin CO2 emissions across up to 15 aircraft profiles for an airport pair (origin + dest) or mission distance (distance_km). Ranks all 15 aircraft profiles when aircraft is omitted.

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or short name among 15 profiles (e.g. airbus-a350-900ulr, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, gulfstream-g650er). If omitted, evaluates and ranks all 15 profiles.

cabin.description: Optional cabin class for per-passenger CO2 scaling. Defaults to economy.

dest.description: Optional 3-letter IATA destination airport code (provide together with origin, or pass distance_km).

distance_km.description: Optional mission distance in kilometers (1-25,000) when origin/dest are omitted.

origin.description: Optional 3-letter IATA origin airport code (provide together with dest, or pass distance_km).

name: evaluate_aircraft_range
